title: Elf Bar ElfLiq x Crystal Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Elfliq x Crystal Watermelon by Elf Bar is a premium evolution of one of the most popular tropical flavours on the market. Part of the exclusive Crystal edition, this blend focuses on delivering a cleaner, more saturated watermelon taste. It captures the lush, aqueous sweetness of ripe red watermelon, offering a refreshing inhale that is bursting with authentic fruit notes. The finish is crisp and light, making it an ideal all-day vape for fruit lovers. Formulated with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid strikes the perfect balance between flavour depth and vapour production. It is engineered for use with MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, such as pod vape kits. The 20mg nicotine salt strength ensures a gentle throat hit without harshness, allowing the refreshing watermelon flavour to take centre stage while delivering fast-acting satisfaction.
